materials.name: Stone
materials.searchTags: stone rock rocks material building pickaxe mine respawn buy meriam crime
materials.zhSearchTags: 石头 石块 岩石 材料 建造 镐 矿洞 刷新 购买 市政厅 犯罪
materials.summary: Collect loose stone on your ranch first. Current official notes also say normal rock gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase; a reliable respawning source is still unverified.
materials.zhSummary: 先收集牧场上的散落石头。官方当前公告也说明，牧场外正常敲石不会触发警察追逐；可靠的可重复刷新来源仍未确认。
materials.whenNeeded: For a building requirement, use loose stone on your ranch first. If you need more, the official no-chase rule covers normal rock gathering outside the ranch; exact deposits and respawn behavior are not established.
materials.zhWhenNeeded: 建造缺石头时先收集牧场上的散落石头。需要更多时，官方说明牧场外正常敲石不会触发警察追逐；具体矿点和刷新规律仍未确认。

facts.text: Current-build players report gathering loose stone from ranch land and eventually exhausting the visible supply.
facts.zhText: 当前版本玩家报告可以收集牧场土地上的散落石头，但可见的初始储量会被采完。

facts.text: Official 0.8.10.871 notes say normal wood and stone gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase. The 0.8.10.868 notes describe this as temporary while dedicated gathering areas are developed; this does not establish rules for taking loose items or every ownership interaction.
facts.zhText: 官方 0.8.10.871 公告说明，牧场外正常采集木材和石头不会触发警察追逐；0.8.10.868 将此说明为等待专门采集区域期间的临时调整。这没有说明拾取散落物或所有权交互的规则。

facts.text: A July 2026 player report warned that taking stone from land you do not own could trigger fines or jail. It predates the 0.8.10.868 change and does not establish the current rule for normal rock gathering; other theft interactions remain unverified.
facts.zhText: 2026 年 7 月的一则玩家报告曾提醒，从非自有地块取石头可能触发罚款或坐牢。该报告早于 0.8.10.868 更新，不能代表当前普通敲石规则；其他偷窃行为仍未确认。

facts.text: Reliable repeatable Stone supply is still being verified. Mines are not available in the reviewed Early Access build.
facts.zhText: 可靠的可重复石头来源仍待验证。当前审查的抢先体验版本尚未开放矿洞。

materials.name: Wood Log
materials.searchTags: wood log timber tree chop charcoal building red tent recipe
materials.zhSearchTags: 原木 木材 木头 砍树 木炭 建造 红帐篷 配方
materials.summary: Cutting trees yields Wood Logs. Official 0.8.10.871 notes say normal wood gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase; respawn timing is unverified.
materials.zhSummary: 砍树可获得原木。官方 0.8.10.871 公告说明，牧场外正常采木不会触发警察追逐；树木刷新时间仍未知。
materials.whenNeeded: Keep Wood Logs for early construction before testing the community charcoal lead; the retained evidence does not establish a universal recipe list.
materials.zhWhenNeeded: 早期建造优先保留原木，再考虑测试社区木炭线索；现有证据不能推出完整配方表。

facts.text: Current community reports obtain Wood Logs by cutting trees; the retained reports do not establish tree respawn timing or ownership rules.
facts.zhText: 当前社区报告通过砍树获得原木；现有资料无法确认树木刷新时间或土地所有权规则。

facts.text: Official 0.8.10.871 notes say normal wood and stone gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase. The 0.8.10.868 notes describe this as temporary while dedicated gathering areas are developed; this does not establish rules for taking loose items or every ownership interaction.
facts.zhText: 官方 0.8.10.871 公告说明，牧场外正常采集木材和石头不会触发警察追逐；0.8.10.868 将此说明为等待专门采集区域期间的临时调整。这没有说明拾取散落物或所有权交互的规则。

facts.text: Launch-build footage shows a Red Tent recipe requiring 10 Wood Logs and 8 Stone; it does not prove other recipe costs.
facts.zhText: 首发版本视频显示红帐篷配方需要 10 个原木和 8 个石头；这不能证明其他配方的材料数量。

materials.name: Hay
materials.searchTitle: Where to get Hay for chickens
materials.zhSearchTitle: 鸡饲料干草在哪里获得
materials.searchTags: hay grass bush crates barrels chicken feed trough silo animal food
materials.zhSearchTags: 干草 草 灌木 木箱 桶 鸡饲料 食槽 筒仓 动物食物
materials.summary: Hay is chicken feed. Official pre-EA notes say wild grass yields it at any growth stage; because that predates Early Access, verify a small test in your current save. A current-build bush/container route remains a single-player lead.
materials.zhSummary: 干草是鸡饲料。EA 前官方说明称任意生长阶段的野草都能产出干草；由于资料早于抢先体验，建议先在当前存档小范围验证。灌木/容器路线仍只有一条当前版本玩家线索。
materials.whenNeeded: When chickens arrive, first try cutting a small patch of wild grass; official Alpha notes say growth stage does not matter, but this has not been reverified in the current Early Access build. If that fails, a current-build report suggests bushes and NPC-farm crates/barrels, not a guaranteed drop table.
materials.zhWhenNeeded: 鸡到家后，可先试割一小片野草；官方 Alpha 说明称生长阶段不限，但该路线尚未按当前抢先体验版本复核。若无效，再参考当前版本玩家提到的灌木和 NPC 农场木箱/桶路线；这不是保证掉落表。

facts.text: Official 2023 Alpha update notes say wild grass produces Hay regardless of growth stage. This is pre-Early Access documentation and does not by itself confirm current-build behavior.
facts.zhText: 2023 年官方 Alpha 更新说明称，野草在任何生长阶段都能产出干草。这是抢先体验前的资料，不能单独证明当前版本行为。

facts.text: An official moderator answer identifies hay as chicken feed; place it in the interior trough or load a connected silo for automation.
facts.zhText: 官方版主确认干草是鸡饲料；可放进鸡舍内部食槽，或装入已连接的筒仓用于自动喂食。

facts.text: One current-build report gets hay by cutting bushes or searching crates and barrels on NPC farms. Treat this as a route to test, not a guaranteed drop table.
facts.zhText: 一条当前版本报告称可通过砍灌木，或搜索 NPC 农场的木箱和桶获得干草。它是待复测路线，不是已确认掉落表。

materials.name: Charcoal
materials.searchTags: charcoal coal burn logs torch fire extinguisher building material
materials.zhSearchTags: 木炭 煤 原木 燃烧 火把 灭火器 建造 材料
materials.summary: Community staff say Charcoal is made by burning wood, not bought. Exact controls, burn time and yield remain unverified.
materials.zhSummary: 社区工作人员明确说明木炭由燃烧木材获得，不是去商店购买。具体操作、燃烧时间和产量仍未验证。
materials.whenNeeded: Check your recipe's Charcoal requirement, keep construction logs separate and test a small amount before scaling up.
materials.zhWhenNeeded: 先查配方所需木炭数量，留好建造原木，小量确认结果后再扩大制作。

facts.text: In the September 23 General Store discussion, community staff say Charcoal is made by burning wood rather than bought. The reply does not specify controls, weather, timing or yield.
facts.zhText: 9 月 23 日 General Store 讨论中，社区工作人员说明木炭由燃烧木材获得，而非购买。该答复没有给出操作按键、天气、计时或产量。

facts.text: Whitebear's August 4 report describes igniting felled or dropped logs with a torch in dry weather, waiting for a material change, and extinguishing the fire before collecting.
facts.zhText: Whitebear 在 8 月 4 日的报告中描述：干燥天气用火把点燃砍下或放下的原木，等待材料变化，灭火后再收集。

facts.text: The report warns that the fire can kill the character. Current-build controls, timing and yield remain unverified.
facts.zhText: 报告提醒火焰可能导致角色死亡。当前版本的操作按键、计时和产量仍未验证。

facts.text: The moderator separately identifies the fire extinguisher as the intended way to put out fires. The retained evidence does not lock down one keyboard control or an exact burn timer.
facts.zhText: 官方版主另行说明灭火器是预期的灭火方式。现有证据不足以锁定唯一键盘操作或精确燃烧计时。

materials.name: Zirconite
materials.searchTitle: Where can I buy Zirconite (Zerkonite)? Meriam at City Hall
materials.zhSearchTitle: 锆矿在哪里买？市政厅的 Meriam
materials.searchTags: zirconite zerkonite meriam city hall architect buy mine material blueprint
materials.zhSearchTags: 锆矿 Zirconite Zerkonite Meriam 市政厅 建筑师 购买 矿洞 材料 蓝图
materials.summary: Buy Zirconite for now. The official moderator says purchasing is the only current route until mines are implemented.
materials.zhSummary: 现阶段需要购买锆矿。官方版主说明，在矿洞实装前，购买是当前唯一途径。
materials.whenNeeded: Check Zirconite when a blueprint or advanced building asks for it. The current route points to Meriam at City Hall; a stable price and wild-ore route remain unverified.
materials.zhWhenNeeded: 当蓝图或高级建造需要锆矿时再查。当前路线指向市政厅的 Meriam；稳定价格和野外矿石路线仍未验证。

facts.text: The official moderator says buying Zirconite is the only current option until mines are implemented; do not search for a wild ore route in this build.
facts.zhText: 官方版主说明，在矿洞实装前，购买锆矿是当前唯一途径；这个版本不必寻找野外矿石路线。

facts.text: Multiple current community answers identify Meriam at City Hall as the seller. The retained evidence does not support publishing a stable current price.
facts.zhText: 多条当前社区回答把市政厅的 Meriam 指为卖家。现有证据不足以发布稳定的当前价格。
